workspace.title: Relay check-in
workspace.waitingHint: Check-in becomes available once the local gateway is ready.
workspace.unavailable: Check-in is not part of this gateway
workspace.unavailableHint: This gateway build does not include the check-in extension. Everything else keeps working.
workspace.unsupported: This gateway speaks a different check-in version
workspace.unsupportedHint: Update the desktop app and the gateway together before using check-in.
workspace.readFailedHint: The rest of the gateway is unaffected. Try again in a moment.
workspace.starting: Check-in is enabled but not ready
workspace.startingHint: Its storage or scheduler did not start. The reason is shown below; retry enabling it after fixing the cause.
workspace.pageFailed: The check-in page could not be loaded
workspace.pageFailedHint: The rest of the app keeps working. Reopen the app to try again.

enable.title: Relay check-in is off
enable.description: Turning it on prepares separate check-in storage and a daily scheduler. No relay site is contacted until you add and connect an account, and automatic check-in stays off for every account until you allow it.
enable.failed: Check-in could not be turned on
enable.confirmDisableBody: The scheduler stops and no further check-in requests are sent. Accounts and records are kept and come back when you turn it on again.

initError.init_failed: Check-in storage could not be prepared.
initError.settings_write_failed: The check-in switch could not be saved.
initError.stop_incomplete: The previous scheduler did not stop in time.
initError.settings_invalid: The saved check-in switch is damaged, so check-in stays off.
initError.settings_unsupported_version: The saved check-in switch comes from a newer version, so check-in stays off.
initError.settings_unreadable: The saved check-in switch could not be read, so check-in stays off.

accounts.emptyHint: Accounts you add here are separate from API providers; connecting one never changes a provider's configuration.

jobs.emptyHint: Records appear here after a check-in or a status refresh runs.

failure.network: the site could not be reached
failure.auth_required: the stored sign-in is no longer accepted
failure.manual_required: the site asks for a step only you can take
failure.unsupported: this site does not offer check-in
failure.account_changed: the account changed while it ran
failure.unconfirmed: a submission was sent but its result was lost

bridge.desktopOnly: Check-in is only available in the desktop app.
bridge.unavailable: This gateway does not include check-in.
bridge.unsupported: This gateway speaks a different check-in version.
bridge.refused: The desktop app refused this request.
bridge.transport: The gateway did not answer. Try again.
bridge.malformed: The gateway returned data this app does not accept.

error.not_found: It no longer exists. Reload the list.
error.account_conflict: An account for this site user already exists.
error.revision_conflict: The account changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving.
error.request_id_reused: This action was already sent with different content. Reload and try again.
error.account_busy: A check-in for this account is running. Try again when it finishes.
error.job_not_cancellable: This job already finished or was sent, so it cannot be cancelled.
error.checkin_stopping: Check-in is stopping. Try again shortly.
error.checkin_storage_failed: Check-in storage failed. The rest of the gateway is unaffected.
error.checkin_settings_failed: The check-in switch could not be saved.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
error.site_unavailable: The site could not be reached. Try again later.
error.identity_mismatch: The site reported a different user than this account. Nothing was saved; connect the account that site actually signed you in as.
error.authorization_not_found: The sign-in session expired. Start again.
error.authorization_completed: This sign-in session was already used.
error.auth_required: The site did not accept that session. Sign in on the site again, copy a fresh Cookie header and retry.
error.manual_required: The site needs a step finished on its own pages, such as a verification, before a session can be checked. Finish it there, then connect again.
error.unsupported: This site cannot verify a session in a way this build supports. The account stays unconnected.

actions.pollFailed: Progress is temporarily unavailable. Only the local receipt will be checked again; no check-in will be resubmitted.
actions.queued: Waiting to run; it can still be cancelled.
actions.sentPending: Sent. The result is being confirmed; a sent submission cannot be withdrawn.
actions.cancelledBeforeSend: Cancelled without sending a check-in submission.
actions.cancelDispatched: It was already sent, so cancelling does not undo it. Only a status refresh can confirm the result.
actions.cancelBatchDispatched: Accounts not yet sent were cancelled. Those already sent are not undone; refresh their status to confirm.
actions.refreshToConfirm: Refresh the status to find out whether it went through.

batch.limitHint: One batch holds at most {{limit}} accounts.

gated.connect: This account has no stored session yet. Use Connect account and paste a Cookie header from your browser; in-app sign-in is not admitted on this platform yet.
gated.manual: In-app handling is not admitted on this platform yet. Finish the step on the site directly, then refresh the status here.

dialog.bindAfterCreate: Add the draft first, then edit it to link providers. Automatic check-in stays off until the account is connected.
dialog.servicesUnavailable: The provider list is not ready. Existing links are kept; reopen the provider page to refresh it before changing links.
dialog.servicesChanged: A selected provider was removed. Review the links before saving.
dialog.description: Only the check-in extension stores this account. No provider configuration is changed.
dialog.dashboardURLHint: The relay's dashboard root, with any sub-path. https only; plain http only for this computer.
dialog.timeZoneHint: An explicit IANA zone that decides the check-in day. It is prefilled from this computer; check it against the site.
dialog.proxyURLHint: http, https or socks5 with host and port only. Never put a user name or password here.
dialog.boundServicesHint: Read only: linking never changes a provider.
dialog.noServices: There are no providers to link yet.
dialog.automaticHint: Only a connected account can check in automatically.
dialog.confirmTarget: I checked the dashboard address and time zone
dialog.redirectWarning: Changing the address or network clears this account's saved sign-in and turns automatic check-in off. It has to be connected again.
dialog.reloaded: The account was changed elsewhere. The latest version is loaded; make your change again.
dialog.automaticBody: AstrLink will schedule daily check-in attempts for this account in its time zone. It never solves a CAPTCHA or works around the site's checks; if the site asks for a person, the account waits for you.
dialog.automaticFeature: It only runs while relay check-in is turned on.

validation.urlCredentials: The address must not contain a user name or password.
validation.urlQuery: The address must not contain a query or fragment.
validation.urlPlainHTTP: Use https; plain http is only accepted for this computer.
validation.timeZoneLocal: Choose an explicit zone such as Asia/Shanghai instead of Local.
validation.timeZoneUnknown: This is not a known IANA time zone.
validation.proxyRequired: A custom network needs a proxy address.
validation.proxyInvalid: Use http, https or socks5 with a host and optional port only.
validation.confirmRequired: Confirm the dashboard address and time zone first.

delete.title: Delete this check-in account?
delete.body: {{host}} is removed with its saved sign-in and its check-in records. Providers are not changed.

connect.description: Sign in to the site in your own browser, then paste the session here. The paste is handed to the local host, which converts it; it is never kept in this window.
connect.pasteHint: One line such as name=value; other=value, or one name=value per line. At most 32 cookies.
connect.privacyNote: The session is sealed by Core and used only for this account's check-in. It is not written to this window's storage or to any log.
connect.retryHint: Paste the session again and retry; this keeps the same request, so a connection that already went through is not repeated.
connect.stepCopy: Open the browser developer tools, pick any request to the site on the Network tab, and copy the whole value of its Cookie request header.
connect.stepSignIn: Sign in to the site in your browser.
connect.title: Connect {{host}}
